meta.name: add-rule
meta.description: Captures a team convention or best practice and adds it to the appropriate .claude/rules/ or .claude/agents/ file

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把团队约定自动写入规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们团队需要把最佳实践固化到项目配置中
copy.tagline_en: Automatically capture team conventions into rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to codify best practices into project config

howto.what: 安装后，当你说出团队约定或最佳实践时，Claude 会将其添加到项目的 .claude/rules/ 或 .claude/agents/ 文件中，使该规则自动适用于所有团队成员。
howto.when: 当你用自然语言描述一个团队约定（例如“测试中优先使用 require.NoError”）时触发。

say.text: 添加规则：CLI 命令必须支持 --format json。
say.note: Claude 会将此规则写入 CLI 规则文件。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you state a team convention or best practice, Claude will add it to the appropriate .claude/rules/ or .claude/agents/ file so the rule applies automatically for all team members.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a team convention in natural language, e.g., "prefer require.NoError over t.Fatal for error assertions".

say_en.text: Add rule: prefer require.NoError over t.Fatal for error assertions.
say_en.note: Claude will add this to the testing rules file.

say_en.text: Add rule: CLI commands must support --format json.
say_en.note: Claude will add this to the CLI rules file.
